definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that displays courage or a bold, spirited bearing. Often carries a heroic or admirable nuance.

examples.japanese: {勇|いさ}ましい{姿|すがた}だった。
{兵士|へいし}たちは{勇|いさ}ましく{行進|こうしん}した。
{彼|かれ}の{勇|いさ}ましい{掛|か}け{声|ごえ}にみんなが{奮|ふる}い{立|た}った。
examples.english: Everyone was inspired by his courageous rallying cry.

notes:
Conveys an outward display of bravery or spirited bearing, often used to describe the appearance, posture, or actions of people (especially warriors, soldiers, or heroes). The word carries a somewhat literary or traditional tone.

CONJUGATION:
・{勇|いさ}ましくない (negative)
・{勇|いさ}ましく (adverbial)
・{勇|いさ}ましかった (past)
・{勇|いさ}ましさ (noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{勇|いさ}ましい{姿|すがた} — gallant/brave figure
・{勇|いさ}ましい{声|こえ} — bold/spirited voice
・{勇|いさ}ましい{行進|こうしん} — a valiant march

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{勇敢|ゆうかん} — courageous (more formal, focuses on inner courage)
・{雄々|おお}しい — manly, heroic (literary)
